name: Is it better to sell my home as-is or make repairs?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to sell my home as-is or make repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: The choice between selling 'as-is' or making repairs depends on the extent of necessary work, your budget, time constraints, and local market demand. Selling as-is can be faster but may result in a lower sale price or attract investors. Making repairs can lead to a higher sale price and broader buyer interest, though it requires an upfront investment of time and money. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution can assess your specific situation and market dynamics in areas such as Miami or Fort Lauderdale to help you determine the best approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Selling 'as-is' is faster but may yield a lower price, while repairs can increase sale price and buyer interest. The best option depends on your situation and local market.
